svg.title: Ship — side schematic
svg.desc: Ship side schematic: spine and spin axis, habitat at the 28 m floor radius, counterweight, boom, ARI core at the hub with the engage lever and the ARI ISOLATE hard line, thrust and nose directions.
svg.text: Seen across the boom plane; nose on the right, habitat below the axis — its “down” is down the sheet
propellant tanks — shield the core from aft
at the habitat station — dynamic balance
the ship’s main node; on the axis, shielded by tanks
tanks shield the core from aft; from the nose only the spine
“down” is radially outward, away from the axis
Draft: dimensions from data/canon.yaml (layout.*, exterior.*), not agreed
